payload.claim:
Any of the following would change my view:
(1) Capex guidance for 2027 plateaus or falls while quarterly FCF turns durably positive and buybacks resume. That would lift the owner-earnings base toward the ~$8.58/share the price implies and close most of the negative margin of safety.
(2) Normalized (ex-investment-gain) EPS grows at or above ~25–29% for several quarters, with Cloud operating margin expanding enough to absorb the depreciation wave.
(3) The downside cases: the Brinkema ad-tech remedy or the search remedy orders AdX divestiture or bans default-placement payments; Search revenue growth decelerates to low single digits; or the integrity gate escalates beyond Flag. Any of these would weaken moat durability and push toward REDUCE.

prediction.reasoning: Depreciation from a $195–205B capex year (and likely more in 2027) will absorb most of the operating leverage from 20%+ revenue growth and Cloud margin gains. EBIT margin should therefore plateau in the mid-30s rather than expand toward the high-30s that a ~29% owner-earnings growth path would require. This is where I differ from the price: I expect margin stagnation, not margin-driven compounding.
